acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec defines the binding from PWP receipts to map elements, the status lattice (VERIFIED@rev, UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD, CONTRADICTED, unverified), evidence-based selector strength, delivery and the OCA-V0 authority limit, with numbered requirements and rollback.

A passing receipt whose test IDs cover a step binds it VERIFIED at the receipt's app revision with a receipt reference; an agent-declared binding whose test ID is absent from the receipt refuses with a stable code.
Changing the step's app source anchor makes it UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD; a failing receipt hitting the step makes it CONTRADICTED; unknown or unresolvable revision never reads VERIFIED.
Map and navigation queries return per-step verification status within their existing byte caps; reads never mutate.
Verified status never upgrades candidate research into behavioural truth or feeds ranking or authority.
body: Owner request https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/658 (2026-10-07). Corpus navigation research is candidate (source-backed, never browser-verified) and says it must be verified before use, yet adopter sessions run those steps daily against a pinned demo with passing Playwright runs and manifests; nothing feeds back, so a weak selector stays weak after 50 green runs and a step broken at the current revision is not flagged. The adopter workaround is an honour-system JSONL with no receipt binding, revision or expiry. Ask: a verification overlay where a passing Playwright external-provider receipt (PWP /1-/3 with app identity) binds to the screen/step/selector it exercised (derived from spec anchors or agent-declared and checked against the receipt test IDs); each element carries VERIFIED@<app revision> with a receipt reference, UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD when its app source anchor changes and CONTRADICTED when a failing receipt hits it; selector strength upgrades only from evidence; map and navigation queries return per-step status. Verification never turns candidate research into a behavioural claim beyond 'worked in this run at this revision' (OCA-V0). Builds on the issue 657 application map.
